gloss: wire mesh; wire netting; metal screen

definitions.gloss: wire mesh; wire netting; metal screen
definitions.explanation: A mesh or net made of interwoven metal wire, used for fencing, grilling, filtering, and various other purposes.

examples.english: To grill meat on a wire mesh.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{金網|かなあみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}けた→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I installed a wire screen on the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{校庭|こうてい}→校庭：04147_koutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まわり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{金網|かなあみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フェンス→フェンス：26996_fensu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{張|は}ってある→張る：12583_haru⟧。
examples.english: A tall wire mesh fence is put up around the schoolyard.

notes:
{金網|かなあみ} is a compound of {金|かな} (metal) + ⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧ (net, mesh). It covers any mesh or netting made from metal wire.
